name: running into/from oblivion
source:
a Witch foolishly tried to attack You, and You're not convinced that He's ready to die just yet

[From [url=https://tofurocks.itch.io/running-into-from-oblivion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名男巫不自量力地企图袭击“你”，而“你”并不觉得他已经做好了赴死的准备。
